title: Apple: Recent Longs Need to Closely Monitor the Divergences Near-Term
text:
Apple: Recent Longs Need to Closely Monitor the Divergences Near-Term By 0 
We took a quick look at Apple (AAPL) earlier this month and we expressed some caution that the candle patterns and some indicators suggested that the trend was weakening. The company has attracted a lot of attention recently as it has responded to the new tax laws that were just enacted. The share price of AAPL was stuck in a sideways trading range for about 2-1/2 months but recently made a new price high. Prices have been pulling back in recent sessions and could retest the $175-$169 support area. Let's look at a few charts and indicators before presenting a fresh strategy. 
In this daily bar chart of AAPL, below, we can see that prices are above the 50-day moving average line. The slope of the 50-day line looks to be slowing/cresting. AAPL is above the rising 200-day moving average line which still looks robust. The daily On-Balance-Volume (OBV) line is not "in gear" with the price action, as it has been flat since early December, and did not move to a new high to match or confirm the new price highs. This volume divergence is a concern in that it tells us that buying enthusiasm is not keeping up the price action.
